title: Yama Tolk and the Inactive Clockwork
summary: Help Yama recharge the inactive clockwork by casting precisely on his cues.
overview: Help Yama recharge the inactive clockwork by casting precisely on his cues.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare the required spell before starting and wait for each charge prompt.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: A qualifying wizard follows the battery dialogue and says ready to start the test.
Four charge stages provide five-second response windows; the script accepts spell 5596 while the charge window is active.
Missing a cue fails the trial and resets the setup.
After the fourth charge, the final stage advances the wizard's quest.

notes: Approval E314. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The callback comment claims same-player enforcement, but the cast callback should be audited before relying on that restriction.
